newsitem.title: USA: Stocks surge higher with major indeces at records.
newsitem.headline: Stocks surge higher with major indeces at records.

text.p: Stocks surged across the board Wednesday with the Dow Jones industrial average, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq all setting record highs.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average jumped 80.36 points to close at 8,254.89. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a 4-1 margin on volume of about 432 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange. The S&P 500 gained 10.02 points to close at 952.31 and the Nasdaq jumped 15.74 points to 1,588.06
